info.title: pragmatic-migrate
info.description: Interactive CLI for Pragmatic.Migrations — schema diff, preview, apply with rich terminal UX.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --version
options.description: Prints version information

options.name: --assembly
options.description:
Path to built host assembly (.dll)
containing SG-generated
SchemaVersion types

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to .csproj file. Builds the
project and loads the output
assembly

options.name: --connection
options.description:
Override connection string for all
databases

options.name: --config
options.description:
Path to appsettings.json for
connection string resolution

options.name: --database
options.description:
Filter to a specific database by
name

options.name: --audit-table
options.description:
Audit table name, when the host
renamed it with UseAuditTable.
Default: __PragmaticSchema

options.name: --drop-unknown-tables
options.description:
Drop tables present in the database
but absent from the declared schema.
Off by default: a table the CLI did
not create may belong to another
system

options.name: --json
options.description:
Output structured NDJSON for
programmatic consumption
(unidirectional)

options.name: --agent
options.description:
Bidirectional NDJSON mode for AI
agent integration (reads stdin,
writes stdout)

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Show SQL for each change as it
executes

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable terminal colors

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Show what would change without
applying

options.name: --force
options.description:
Apply breaking changes without
per-change confirmation

options.name: --yes
options.description:
Non-interactive mode: auto-confirm
safe changes, block breaking (unless

options.description:
30         Migration timeout in minutes.
Default: 30
